<p class="reine-meaning" id="reine-meaning">Resilience, Energy, and Inequity in Neighborhood Environments</p>

<p class="hero-tagline">We study how environmental exposures and climate adaptation shape health equity in the United States and West Africa, generating evidence for more equitable energy and climate policy.</p>

<script>
(function() {
  var el = document.getElementById('reine-meaning');
  if (!el) return;
  var messages = [
    'Resilience, Energy, and Inequity in Neighborhood Environments',
    '“Reine” is also French for “queen.”'
  ];
  var i = 0;
  setInterval(function() {
    el.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(function() {
      i = (i + 1) % messages.length;
      el.textContent = messages[i];
      el.style.opacity = 1;
    }, 400);
  }, 5000);
})();
</script>

### What we study

- Energy Transitions & Equity
- Climate, Infrastructure, and Health
- Environmental Justice Methods

### Inspiration

**Solastalgia:** the distress and loss of solace caused by environmental change close to home, felt even while still living there. A term coined by philosopher Glenn Albrecht.

**Audre Lorde:** "The master's tools will never dismantle the master's house."
